profile.headline: Software Engineer at Quickbase
profile.summary:
Quality-oriented technology professional with a strong focus on Web development and Mobile application development. Commendable skills in Java, JavaScript, MySQL, React, Node.js, and Express.js.

Technical skills:
Programming Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, Swift
Systems: Linux, Windows, Mac
Tools: Visual Studio Code, Android Studio, NetBeans, Postman, Git, CircleCI
Database: MySQL, MSSQL Server, MongoDB, SQLite
Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Node.js, Express.js, React, Redux, GraphQL, Spring, Hibernate, Angular, NextJS
Mobile Development: Android, iOS, React Native, Ionic Framework
AWS Services: EC2, RDS, S3, ELB, AutoScaling, CodeDeploy, CloudWatch, Route 53, Lambda

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
• Conducted UI refresh of timeline report (Gantt Chart) for the Quick Base platform in team of 4; implemented by Fortune 500 companies such as Walmart, Southwest Airlines and Sprint
• Designed an UI practising React, Redux; fetched server data exerting GraphQL Apollo client; Jest and Enzyme as a unit testing framework; developed scalable APIs in C++ with MSSQL Server; Java for API testing

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Led lab sessions for master's students to enlighten Java and swing application concepts, evaluated students assignments and lab work and prepared quizzes for students on HackerRank
• Organized TA hours to elucidate Java related questions and gave input and direction to students by supervising one to one and in small group gathering to resolve any difficulties faced by scholars

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Undertook cross-platform mobile application development applying Ionic Framework on top of the Angular.js
• Designed 2 high-quality hybrid mobile application for both platform, Android and iOS, using Apache Cordova
• Devised water utilization system mobile application with team of 3 over 2 months; supervised daily water tracking with option to share PDF on social media; Formulated Vibrant School of Excellence mobile application, manages student academic activity, school notifications for parents, with team of 4 over 3 months
• Created Backend APIs in C# with MSSQL Server stored procedure using ASP.NET web application framework

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
positions.description: •Effectuated Milk Diary, an android application; with team of 2 sanctions milk dairy to manage billing for dairy customers. Also, It permits customers to view bill PDF. Firebase database was used for back-end
